sessions.summary: Covestro INC37675140 follow-up: email activity ingestion succeeded; failures were outbound CX Flow sync during concurrent WSSE+OAuth2 overlap (73min). OAuth2 token endpoint flooded with 429s from dual-flow architecture. Identified documentation gap: public SAP Help Portal lacks explicit warning to disable old CX flows before migration. Created concept notes: INC37675140 (Changelog entry), Emarsys OAuth2 Migration (new note on doc gap).
sessions.outcome: Consultation session resolved; remediation path (audience re-activation) confirmed idempotent; doc gap flagged for team awareness

sessions.summary: SAP IT Business Systeme INC37704892: two activity attributes (externalDataController, leadDescription) under newly-enabled Outbound Data Governance intermittently not sent to BTP during Oct 1 15:00–15:07 UTC and Oct 6 13:50–13:55 UTC windows. Traced drop to activation/governance mapping stage (not HTTP send). Source data present; profile stores extDataCntr_CF array; DataSync purpose granted. Root cause hypothesis: governance layer performs live getConsents check at activation time; endpoint timed out during both windows causing field nulling (fail-closed behavior). Escalated to R&D data team with full handoff detailing trace steps and hypothesis. Created concept notes: INC37704892 (incident), Outbound Data Governance (feature concept).
sessions.outcome: Investigation traced drop location; escalated to R&D for code-level confirmation on getConsents timeout failure mode

sessions.summary: Investigated INC34694385 (SAP IT Business Systeme eu5 prod): activePipelineCount field dropped from AEP S3 audience export when account lacks matching activity. Traced full outbound pipeline (idx-cdp reader, Cdp.Mapping TargetBuilder, Cdp.JsonVerifier, QueryService ProfileMapper, AudienceService) and empirically ruled out file-writer null-stripping, schema validation drop, and CSV/compliment gating using real exported file. Localized defect to QueryService V2 mapping: ReplaceEmptyWithNull nulls missing Data-schema fields but not ActivityIndicators-sourced fields. Built failing unit test on current github/develop branch bug/CXCDP-45262-activity-indicator-null-drop with fixture Data/inc34694385/. Filed Jira Bug CXCDP-45262 under epic CXCDP-44866, assigned to CDP Data Management (Orit Yafe). Also edited cdp-investigate skill Step 0 to load primers + search team KB before investigating.
sessions.outcome: Root cause localized to QueryService V2 mapping logic; failing repro test built; bug filed and handed to Orit Yafe for implementation
